title: Photopea
description: A browser-based image editor for PSD, XD, Sketch, and common image files.
steps: Choose File → Open to load an image, or select New Project.
Edit your image and use File → Export As to save it.

title: Khan Academy
description: Free lessons and practice in subjects including math, science, and computing.
steps: Browse a subject or use the search field to find a topic.
Choose a course or lesson to start learning.

title: OpenStreetMap
description: A collaborative, open map for exploring places and planning routes.
steps: Search for a place or address.
Select Directions and enter your starting point.

title: itch.io
description: Discover independent games, tabletop games, and creative projects.
steps: Browse a category or search for a game.
Open a game's page to view details and available downloads.

title: remove.bg
description: Remove the background from an image with an online tool.
steps: Review the result and download it if it meets your needs.

title: Internet Archive
description: Explore a digital library of books, movies, music, websites, and more.
steps: Search for a title, subject, or creator.
Open a result to see its available formats and access options.
